thread:
Ben: rolling a stacked deploy tonight 00:30 UTC for API, runtime, console, router. Heads-up for cross-service merges.
Aisha: window acked. pin runtime image to redwood/runtime:v2.3.1 to avoid kernel churn.
Marcos: router change is header-split gating. will only flip on canary 5% then 25% then 100%.
Ben: good. API has a tiny contract tweak (optional field) — no client break expected. release notes: https://go/release/1729
DevEx: remember to include schema migration note for eval-ing old prompts.
SRE Oncall: rollback criteria: error spike >0.5% sustained 5m OR p99 latency >200ms across any region.
Marcos: agreed. adding a throttled fallback to old router if error spike.
deploy-bot: /deploy release=coordinated-shard-fuse --services=api,runtime,console,router --waves=canary:5,stage:25,all:100
Ben: starting canary in 10m. watch logs, tracing, token-cost deltas.
Aisha: ops note: dedicated pools will be pinned, autoscale disabled during window.
SRE Oncall: I'll set an alert dashboard and a temporary SLA override for noisy metrics.
Marcos: if canary OK for 20m, proceed to 25%. If any regressions revert runtime to v2.3.0 and router to previous variant.
Ben: publish short release note in #eng-releases once all waves pass. Also add rollback command snippet:
Ben: ```
kubectl -n infra rollout undo deployment/runtime --to-revision=prev
deploy-bot rollback release=coordinated-shard-fuse --services=runtime,router
```
DevEx: tagging @marcos @SRE Oncall in the release note.
Marcos: :thumbsup: I'll watch the console dashboards.
deploy-bot: Canary started (5%). logs: https://go/logs/xyz
SRE Oncall: seeing a tiny latency blip in eu-west, keeping watch. Incremental hold at 5m.
Aisha: thanks — if it stabilizes continue, else we'll trigger rollback.
Ben: update in 15m.
DevEx: added changelog entry and user-facing blurb.
Marcos: canary passed 20m, moving to 25%.
deploy-bot: Wave complete (25%). Next: all:100 scheduled +10m.
SRE Oncall: metrics look steady, no error spikes.
Ben: proceeding to 100%.
deploy-bot: Release complete. All services at new variant. :tada:
Marcos: leaving postmortem notes in the release doc, flagging the eu-west blip for follow-up.
SRE Oncall: marking incident as avoided. Closing the window.
Ben: thanks team.
